Three-clade amphora tree — visualised

dated MCC tree: pot profiles, clade/origin colouring, posterior support, age HPDs

Root ≈ 1281 BCE, youngest tip ≈ 164 BCE. Deepest split (posterior 1.00) separates squat (pelike) from elongate (loutrophoros + panathenaic); Greek and Italiote intermingle within every clade.

1. Dated tree with pot profiles

Pots filled by clade, tip labels coloured by origin, posterior support (≥ 0.5) at nodes, calendar axis.

2. Node ages with 95% HPD bars

Blue bars = 95% highest-posterior-density interval on each node’s age. Tips coloured by origin, posterior support at nodes. This shows how well the dates are pinned down (short bar = confident, long bar = uncertain).
